blocks.text: Why technical recruiters choose Notion on mac

Technical recruiters need a flexible workspace to track candidates. Notion allows you to build custom databases for every open role. You can create different views like Kanban boards for your pipeline or tables for candidate lists. The Mac app is fast and supports native shortcuts, making it easy to move between pages.
Essential Notion tips for your recruiting workflow

items: Use /database to quickly create a new candidate tracker.
Press ⌘ + P to search your entire workspace without using the mouse.
Create a template for interview scorecards to ensure consistency.
Use the Table of Contents block for long candidate profiles.
Add a Callout block to highlight important candidate details or red flags.

blocks.text: Consistency is key. If you have a standard intake process, build it into a database template. This saves you from typing the same questions for every new hire. You can also link databases to keep track of hiring managers and their specific needs.
Saving time with Lazur in Notion

Lazur lives in your Mac notch. When you feel stuck in a complex Notion database, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask for help. Lazur can point to specific menu items or explain how to set up a property. This keeps you in your flow state instead of searching through help articles.

When you have dozens of candidates, use filters to keep your view clean. Filter by status, such as Phone Screen or Technical Interview. This helps you focus on the most urgent tasks first. If you need to share a view with a hiring manager, use the share menu to grant them read-only access.
Common mistakes recruiters make in Notion

Many recruiters create too many pages. Keep your workspace flat. Use databases instead of static pages. Another mistake is forgetting to lock pages. If you share a page with a hiring manager, use the lock feature to prevent accidental deletions or edits to your structure.

Start by auditing your current Notion setup. Identify the manual tasks you repeat every day. Create a template for those tasks. Then, use Lazur to help you refine your database properties. This combination will give you back time for actual recruiting.

faq.question: How do I speed up my workflow in Notion on Mac?
faq.answer: Use keyboard shortcuts like ⌘ + P for search and / to insert blocks. Use Lazur to ask questions instead of clicking through menus.

faq.question: Can Lazur edit my Notion pages?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or edit files. It points at screen elements and explains how to do tasks so you can do them yourself.

faq.question: What is the best way to track candidates in Notion?
faq.answer: Use a database with different views, such as a Kanban board for pipeline stages and a table for contact info.

faq.question: How do I share candidate notes with hiring managers?
faq.answer: Use the Share button at the top right of your page to invite people via email or link.
